'''Nuvar''' was a [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]]<ref name="SWAJ13" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] near the modern [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. In [[3701 BBY]], [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea's]] scoutship [[Hope (scoutship)|''Hope'']] crash-landed on uncharted Nuvar after it was crippled by the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] [[Thoax Osaax|Thoax]] and [[Farge Osaax]], leaving her stranded for six standard years. [[Banu Hydia]] located her on the planet and found her in a wild state.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

Kallea's experiences on Nuvar were dramatized in Acts II and III of [[Trebian Shullos]]'s epic [[Opera/Legends|opera]] [[The Kallea Cycle]],<ref name="TEA" /> and the presentation of the opera on [[Brentaal]] in 38 [[Great ReSynchronization|GrS]] included a rotating Jungle of Nuvar set on [[Votrad Stadium]]'s 500-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long stage.<ref name="SWAJ13" />
